001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
010
011public class TestGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
012
013        @Override
014        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
015                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
016                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
017                result.add(new TestGhost(manager));
018                return result;
019        }
020        
021}
